気になった一節や考えたことは、チャット形式の読書メモで気軽に残せます。一冊との対話の記録が積み重なっていくことで、本との関係が深まり、後から読み返したときに当時の自分の感覚も一緒に蘇ります。

バーコードスキャンで蔵書登録は数秒。ジャンルやステータス、評価別の読書統計で、自分がどんな読書をしてきたかを振り返れます。読書好きの世界観を大切に、装飾より本そのものが映えるデザインを目指しました。

faq.question: データはどこに保存されますか？

faq.question: アカウントやデータを削除するには？

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Reading Memory is run by an individual developer based in Japan, who is the controller of your data under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and similar laws. Contact details are at the end of this page.

sections.title: Why we use your information, and our legal bases
paragraphs: We use the information only for the purposes below. We do not use it for advertising, we do not sell it, and we do not track you across other companies' apps or websites. We do not hand over your notes or page photos for training AI. The text after each purpose is the GDPR legal basis for people in the EU, the UK and similar regions.
items: To provide the app (sign-in, storing and syncing your books, records and notes, reading pages, key points and summaries, and Memory Plus): performance of our contract with you (GDPR Article 6(1)(b))

To understand how the app is used and improve it, and to measure where installs and purchases come from: our legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f)). We limit this to information that does not include your notes or the content of your books and has little impact on you

sections.title: Service providers and transfers outside the EU
paragraphs: We are based in Japan, and we use outside service providers to store and process the information. Their servers are outside the EU, including in the United States and Japan.

The EU recognizes Japan as providing an adequate level of protection (an adequacy decision). Transfers to the United States and other countries are protected by the safeguards each provider offers, such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

sections.title: How long we keep it
items: Your account and your books, reading records, sticky notes, notebooks, notes and profile photo: while you have an account. They are deleted when you delete your account
Photos of pages: not stored on our servers. They are sent to a service provider while the text is read, and that provider handles them under its own rules
Action records: as long as needed to improve the app. They are linked to an ID for each device the app is installed on, not to your account ID
Purchase and analytics records held by our service providers are kept under each provider's own rules

sections.title: Deleting your account
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time in the app under Settings → Delete Account (「設定」→「アカウントを削除」 in Japanese). This deletes your sign-in account; your books, reading records, sticky notes, notebooks, notes and profile photo on the server; and data from app versions 1.4.0 and earlier. It cannot be undone.

Deleting your account does not cancel Memory Plus, and you will keep being billed on the App Store. Cancel it in the App Store first. Deleting the app alone does not delete your records on the server.

sections.title: Requesting access, deletion and more
paragraphs: You can ask us to give you access to, correct, or delete your information, to restrict or stop using it, or to give you a copy to take elsewhere. Email us at the address below. We will normally reply within one month. We may ask you a few questions to confirm that the account is yours.
If you live in the EU, the UK or a similar region, you can also complain to the data protection authority in your country.

faq.question: Where is my data stored?

faq.question: Do I need an internet connection?
faq.answer: Yes, you need an internet connection to sign in and to sync your data. While offline you can still view cached data, but adding or editing requires an online connection.

faq.question: How do I delete my account and data?
faq.answer: You can permanently delete your account and all of your data from "Delete Account" in the Settings tab. This cannot be undone.

faq.question: What is the difference between free and Memory Plus?
faq.answer: Adding books is free, with no limit on how many. Sticky notes, notebooks, reading text from pages, reading cards and stamps, the calendar and widgets are also free for good. sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Reward Habits is run by an individual developer based in Japan, who is the controller of your data under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and similar laws. Contact details are at the end of this page.

sections.title: Why we use your information, and our legal bases
paragraphs: We use the information only for the purposes below. We do not use it for advertising, we do not sell it, and we do not track you across other companies' apps or websites. The text after each purpose is the GDPR legal basis for people in the EU, the UK and similar regions.
items: To provide the app (sign-in, backup and sync of your records, Premium, and the notifications you allow): performance of our contract with you (GDPR Article 6(1)(b))

To understand how the app is used and improve it, and to measure where installs and purchases come from: our legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f)). We limit this to information that does not include the content of your records and has little impact on you

sections.title: Service providers and transfers outside the EU
paragraphs: We are based in Japan, and we use outside service providers to store and process the information. Their servers are outside the EU, including in the United States and Japan.

The EU recognizes Japan as providing an adequate level of protection (an adequacy decision). Transfers to the United States and other countries are protected by the safeguards each provider offers, such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

sections.title: How long we keep it
items: Your account and your habits, rewards, goals, and completion and exchange records: while you have an account. They are deleted when you delete your account

Action records and purchase records: as long as needed to improve the app and understand revenue. After you delete your account, we replace your ID with a random ID and keep them in a form that is no longer linked to you
Device information for notifications: deleted when you sign out, when you delete your account, or when the notification delivery service reports that the device can no longer be reached

Pacts and share link images: deleted 90 days after a pact ends or after you share. They are also deleted when you delete your account. A pact with another person is marked as ended, and your name is no longer shown to them
Purchase records held by our service providers are kept under each provider's own rules

sections.title: Deleting your account
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time in the app under Settings → Delete Account (「設定」→「アカウントを削除」 in Japanese). This deletes your sign-in account; your habits, rewards, goals, and completion and exchange records on the server and on this device; and the device information for notifications. It cannot be undone.
Action records and purchase records are kept with your ID replaced by a random ID. They do not contain the names of your habits or rewards, amounts, or text you type.
Deleting your account does not cancel Premium, and you will keep being billed on the App Store. Cancel it in the App Store first. Deleting the app alone does not delete your records on the server.

sections.title: Requesting access, deletion and more
paragraphs: You can ask us to give you access to, correct, or delete your information, to restrict or stop using it, or to give you a copy to take elsewhere. Email us at the address below. We will normally reply within one month. We may ask you a few questions to confirm that the account is yours.
If you live in the EU, the UK or a similar region, you can also complain to the data protection authority in your country.

faq.question: How does a reward get closer?
faq.answer: Add a habit you want to keep and set the value of one completion. Each time you complete that habit, your reward gets closer. There is also a streak bonus that grows the longer you keep going.

faq.question: Are the numbers in the app real money?
faq.answer: No. The numbers exist only inside the app and cannot be withdrawn as cash or points. You exchange them for "rewards" you choose yourself, to help you keep going.

faq.question: Where is my data stored?
faq.answer: It is stored on this device and also backed up to the server with an anonymous account (free). With Premium, you can connect Apple or Google to sync across multiple devices and carry your data over when you change phones.

faq.question: Can I keep my data when I change phones?
faq.answer: Yes, if you connect Apple or Google with Premium. On the new device, restore your purchase with the same Apple ID, then connect the same account.

faq.question: I bought "Remove Ads" before
faq.answer: Ads were removed in 3.0. If you bought "Remove Ads" before, you can keep using Premium as is. On a new device, tap "Restore purchases".

faq.question: Reminder notifications do not arrive
faq.answer: In iOS Settings → Notifications → Reward Habits, check that notifications are allowed. For each habit, you can set the days and time of its notification on the habit's edit screen.

faq.question: How does a reward get closer?

faq.question: Are the numbers in the app real money?

faq.question: Where is my data stored?
faq.answer: It is stored on this device and also backed up to the server with an anonymous account (free). With Premium, you can connect Apple or Google to sync across multiple devices and carry your data over when you change phones.

faq.question: Can I keep my data when I change phones?
faq.answer: Yes, if you connect Apple or Google with Premium. On the new device, restore your purchase with the same Apple ID, then connect the same account.

faq.question: I bought "Remove Ads" before

faq.question: Reminder notifications do not arrive
faq.answer: In iOS Settings → Notifications → Reward Habits, check that notifications are allowed. For each habit, you can set the days and time of its notification on the habit's edit screen.
